full_judgment: 2. The case of the petitioners is that their father late Mr. Bashir opted for Pakistan after partition of India and came to East Pakistan in the last part of 1947 and has been living therein with his wife Alimunnessa alias Aliman. The petitioner No. 1 was born on 1.1.1950 and the petitioner No. 2 was born on 5.2.53 at Dhaka. The house property No. 6A/8, Block F, Joint Quarter, Mohammadpur was allotted to the said Alimunnessa alias Aliman, the mother of the petitioners by the then Government of East Pakistan vide letter No. 585 AO dated 16.6.62 and thereafter, a lease deed was executed by the Government in favour of the mother of the petitioners on 28.3.63. Father of the petitioners died in the year 1954 and the petitioners with their mother continued to reside in the said house till June, 1974 but in the second week of June, 1974 the petitioners and their mother were ousted from the said property by some goondas and subsequently. Mr. Aftabuddin, Deputy Secretary of the Ministry of Works treated the said property as abandoned property although the mother of the petitioners showed her title deeds and other documents in respect of the said property. After being evicted from the said house, the petitioners shifted to Begum Bazar, Dhaka along with their mother. The mother of the petitioners filed an application before the Secretary, Ministry of Works on 6.8.1974 praying for releasing the said property but without any result. The mother of the petitioners died on 10.3.75 at Dhaka and she was buried in the Mohammadpur Jame Masjid and Idgah graveyard. After the death of the petitioner's mother they filed an application before the Secretary, Ministry of Works on 2.7.78 and to the Deputy Secretary (Abandoned property). Ministry of Public Works on 25.1.81 but without any result. The petitioners obtained a succession Certificate for realisation of arrear rent from the Rural Electrification Board which was their tenant. Thereafter, the petitioners filed Title Suit No. 81 of 1986 in the First Court of Munsif, Dhaka for declaration of their title and recovery of possession but during the pendency of the suit the Government listed the said property as abandoned property in the Gazette Notification dated 23.9.86 under Ordinance No. 54 of 1985. The petitioners sent a registered notice with A/D to the Secretary, Ministry of Works on 17.8.87 to exclude the said house from the list of abandoned houses but in vain. Thereafter, the petitioners had filed the aforesaid ease before the Court of Settlement and withdrew their title suit. The petitioners filed all the connected papers before the Court of Settlement and asserted their claim by stating the facts as stated above.
